title: Nimbus escalation
description: Wire contract for the three edge-to-cloud escalation types fixed by PRD v5.0 FR-9 and Table 2. Every escalation carries a message_id (FR-8: repeats are dropped) and the lease_version it was produced under; the cloud drops escalations whose lease_version is outdated. The payload keys per type follow Table 2's Contains column: CLARIFY carries the question and possible readings, UNEXPECTED_EVENT carries what happened, where, and what robots saw, OUTPUT_READY carries where the result is stored.

type.description: The three escalation types (FR-9); no other edge-to-cloud traffic exists apart from leases and check-ins.

message_id.description: Unique per message; a repeated message_id is dropped rather than acted on twice (FR-8).

lease_version.description: Lease version the escalation was produced under; outdated versions are dropped.

payload.description: Type-specific contents, required keys fixed per type below (PRD Table 2).

result_ref.description: Where the result is stored (cloud storage URI); results cross the WAN only inside OUTPUT_READY, never as a raw stream.
